name: Tutor
overview: The Bible presents the role of a tutor as one of guidance and disciplined nurturing until a designated time, as seen in Galatians where an heir is under tutors and governors until the father’s appointed time. This concept of caretakers or 'nourishers' is also reflected in 2 Kings, where those who raised royal children held significant responsibility. Additionally, Paul’s testimony in Acts highlights the importance of being taught under a respected teacher, Gamaliel, emphasizing instruction according to God’s law. Together, these verses reveal that tutors serve as authoritative instructors preparing those under their care for maturity and responsibility in God’s plan.
